name: Rankou Matsuri!
source:
A traditional festival named "Chigiri Matsuri" in my father's native village turns out to be an orgy party.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE052638.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
父亲故乡的传统祭典“契祭”原来是群交派对。

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE052638.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
